sentences.text: Shri Shakti Prakash Pandey - Advocate for the applicant.
Ms. Geeta Yadav - Government Advocate for the State.

Order 
This is second application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant who has been arrested relating to FIR/Crime No.151/2023 dated 28.06.2023 registered at Police Station Aagasaud, District Sagar for the offences punishable under Sections 304B, 498A, 34 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 24.07.2023 and the trial will take considerable time to conclude.
He further submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
The applicant is a permanent resident of district and is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by the Court.
Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
3. Learned counsels for the State has opposed the bail application.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5. This second bail application has been argued on the ground of delay in trial.
It is claimed that the applicant is in custody since 24.07.2023 and till date only one witness has been examined before the trial Court.

The earlier bail application of applicant was dismissed on merits under M.Cr.C.
No.51363/2023.

From the order-sheets of the trial Court, it is reflected that the trial is definitely progressing at a slow pace as only one witness has been examined so far while the charges were Guddibai @ Laltabai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91797764/
1 framed on 31.10.2023, but it cannot be ignored here that applicant is facing the charge of Sections 498A and 304B of IPC along with Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
6.

sentences.text:
Considering the gravity of crime, this application cannot be allowed, but it needs to be directed that the trial Court is required to take sincere measures to speed up the trial and follow the procedure applicable to Sessions trial by fixing a complete session instead of adjourning the case for individual dates.
7. Accordingly, the M.Cr.C. is disposed off.
(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE DevS Guddibai @ Laltabai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 13 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91797764/
